videos.desc: In a hand-painted seaside cottage a man's loose trousers keep slipping down; he panics, grabs a brown leather belt hanging on a chair, threads it through the loops, buckles it and happily dances now that his trousers stay up.

A hiker laces up tall brown leather boots on a muddy hill path, then stomps through puddles and mud and climbs onto wet rocks with a border collie alongside; the group continues up the green trail in their boots.

In a tailor's workshop a jar of spare buttons is poured out and one button is held up to the light; a man then buttons his blue shirt completely crooked while the tailor counts 'one, two, three - all wrong', and she refastens it properly so the shirt finally sits straight.

On a sunny tropical street a man squints and shields his eyes until his friend in a teal cap hands him a coral one; he puts it on with relief, briefly tries it backwards, laughs and turns the brim forward again.

On a frosty bridge a woman swings a long camel coat over her sweater and scarf, slips her arms in, buttons it up, pops the collar and ties the belt. She twirls to show it off while her friend gives a thumbs up, then they walk off.
videos.said: Now I'm ready. Do your worst!

videos.desc: A young man in a white shirt pops his collar up straight and poses proudly while his friend reacts in shock; after saying "Leave it up. No!" he folds the collar back down flat.

In a cotton field at golden hour, a young couple picks a fluffy white cotton boll, holds it up to the light and feels how soft it is, then presses it against the man's white t-shirt as he laughs "that's my shirt", and the woman blows the fluff off her palm.

A red summer dress hangs on a hanger under a lemon tree while a hand points out that it is all one piece. A young woman then wears it in the courtyard, checks herself in a mirror and twirls so the skirt flares out while a man applauds.
videos.said: All one piece? Whoa! Spin again!

videos.desc: Two models in elegant oversized suits, one cream and one taupe, pose and twirl for a phone photographer on a Paris street. They adjust their jackets, strut past cafe terraces like on a runway, and a little dog in a sweater trots along with them.
On a park bench by a duck pond, a squinting red-haired woman guesses there are three ducks, then cleans her round glasses with a cloth, puts them on and gasps that there are actually seven.

By a foggy canal in the rain a young man pulls the hood of his navy hoodie over his head and tightens the drawstrings until only his grinning face shows, while his girlfriend in a maroon hoodie laughs; they walk off arm in arm.
At a marina at sunset a man pulls a rust-brown jacket on over his sweater, zips it up and shows it off, then walks along the pier with his girlfriend.
In a leather workshop, a craftswoman and a customer stretch a large tan hide that creaks between their hands; she brushes and polishes a leather belt, and he happily tries on a brown leather jacket.

On a terrace full of pink flowers, a young woman holds up a colorful beaded necklace of red, blue and yellow strands. Her friends help her slip it over her head onto her white shirt, and she admires it in a small hand mirror, delighted.

A young woman and a guy lay clothes out on a bed, swapping pieces: a rust jacket, a cream blouse, dark jeans traded for cream trousers, white sneakers and a straw hat. She then wears the finished combination and checks herself in the mirror while he cheers.

A red-haired young man by a stone wall pats himself down asking "Where are they?" and digs through the many pockets of his green jacket, pulling out random things like a pebble, a wrapper and a woolly glove. Finally he fishes his keys out of a pocket and holds them up in relief while his friend sips coffee.
videos.said: Where are they? In your pocket.

videos.desc: A woman buckles a pair of tan leather sandals on her bare feet on a sunny boardwalk; she and a man in brown sandals walk together by the water, she dips a sandalled foot near a tiled fountain, and the camera keeps returning to their strappy open shoes.

A young man takes a light-blue button-up shirt off a hanger, puts it on over his white T-shirt, buttons it up and fixes the collar and cuffs in front of a mirror while a woman watches approvingly and smooths the fabric.

A close-up shows someone sliding a foot into brown leather shoes with a shoe horn, lacing them up with a double knot, then walking out onto a brick street, splashing through a puddle and meeting a friend holding coffee.

In an anime workshop, a silver-haired woman takes tarnished black discs and a dull chain from a box and rubs them with a cloth until they shine bright mirror-silver; she puts on the gleaming silver earrings and chain and admires the sparkle.

At a seaside hat stall a girl tries on straw hats: one is far too small, the next is comically huge and swallows her whole head, and finally the vendor hands her one that fits perfectly and she walks off happy.
videos.said: Too small! Too big! This one fits.

videos.desc: A woman in a park shows off a mustard-yellow pleated skirt: she holds the waistband, lifts the fabric to show how it hangs, walks down stone steps and twirls so the skirt flares out.

In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a young red-haired woman in purple workout clothes laces up a pair of bright teal sneakers on a stone ledge, then happily bounds and jumps up the colorful hillside stairs of a seaside town.
In a tailor's fabric shop a man takes a bright blue suit from the rack, pulls on the jacket over his t-shirt, buttons it and turns proudly in front of the mirrors while his partner admires the fit.
On a rainy day indoors a red-haired woman unfolds a cream cable-knit sweater, presses it to her cheek, pulls it on over her shirt and snuggles into the collar with a hot mug beside her boyfriend.
A man browses a drawer of folded shirts while a woman watches, picks out a teal T-shirt, sniffs it happily, pulls it on over his tank top and checks himself in the mirror as she applauds.
videos.said: No. No. Maybe. That one. One second. Done.

videos.desc: In a tattoo studio, an artist peels the protective film off a woman's upper arm to reveal a fresh bird-and-rose tattoo. She gasps in delight, compares it with the paper sketch the artist holds up, and both give thumbs up.
videos.said: Exactly like the sketch! It's forever!

videos.desc: A young woman knots a dark red tie around the collar of a man's white shirt, chanting "over, under, through"; the first knot comes out too short, so she redoes it and pats the finished tie flat.
videos.said: Over. Under. Through. Too short. Over. Under. Through. There we go.

videos.desc: A cartoon lumberjack in a log cabin takes a white undershirt from a drawer and puts it on first, then piles on a sweater, puffy jacket, hat and scarf before stepping into a blizzard; back inside he strips down to his underwear and gives a cozy thumbs up.

In an animated snowy town street, a blond young person in a teal puffer jacket grips the zipper pull with gloved hands and pulls it all the way up to the chin, then flips the hood up and grins as snow falls.

Extreme close-up of the zipper on a rust-orange ski jacket. A blonde woman in a red beanie outside a snowy cabin fights with the stuck zipper, yanks it free and pulls it up over her chin, grinning at her friend before they walk off with ski poles.

Top-down view of two people standing toe to toe on a wooden floor. One wears bright yellow slippers with big googly eyes and a pink tongue sticking out; the other wears a matching set in green. They shuffle their feet until the two sets line up facing each other like cartoon monsters.

An animated short about a man being transformed. He sits slumped on the sofa in a dark living room playing a video game while an angry woman stands behind him with her arms folded. She drags him out of the door. He then appears outside a smart townhouse in a navy suit and tie, standing tall and confident while two women look him over admiringly. A huge eye peers through a gap in the door. Finally the couple walk back into the house together.

An animated city street at sunset with cartoon pigeons on the pavement. A small grey pigeon wears a glowing pink diamond ring that sparkles and casts pink light over its feathers. A white pigeon with pink-tinted feathers leans in beside it, admiring the ring with wide eyes and an open beak, while a huge dark pigeon with heavy eyelids looms over both of them in the background. The white pigeon presses herself against the grey one, then rears up, opens her beak wide and shouts with one wing raised. At the end the two walk off together side by side down the street, the ring still glowing between them.
videos.said: You fine. Hey, hey, back off. I'm his wife. I don't see any ring on that finger. You belong to the sky!
